sector: Hospitality SaaS: open, API-first cloud property management platform for hotels and serviced apartments

thesis_fit.note: Vertical SaaS (hospitality). Not AI/deep tech/defense/energy. Matches Rockaway Ventures' 'digitise traditional industries' framing, not the AI/deep-tech bucket.

rockaway.amount: Round total EUR 9m after extension; size of Rockaway ticket and of the extension itself not stated
rockaway.lead: Rockaway Ventures and Serpentine Ventures (co-leads, both new investors)

prior_investors.name: apaAngels (friends-and-partners angel network of hotel/hotel-tech people, individuals not named)

events.description: Company says it was founded in January 2017 (statement in seed announcement; no Handelsregister entry date retrieved).
events.note: Date comes from company's own press release, not the registry. Munich Startup (2017-07-11) also says January 2017.

events.description: Earliest 2017 Wayback capture of apaleo.com (HTTP 301). Domain has captures back to 2011 under other/unknown use, so this does not prove the apaleo site existed then.
events.note: First capture with status 200 is 2017-10-27 (https://www.apaleo.com/), 64.1 months before T0.

events.description: Seed financing completed, funded by 'apaAngels' (friends of founders from hotel industry); amount undisclosed. Press release also states founding in Jan 2017, development start Feb 2017.
events.note: Earliest dated public item found. Munich Startup covered it on 2017-07-11 (https://www.munich-startup.de/news/apaleo-seed-finanzierung), team about 15 people.

events.description: First Wayback capture of www.apaleo.com with status 200.
EUR 4.5m Series A led by Force Over Mass, with Redalpine and Bayern Kapital. Also covered by tech.eu on 2021-03-31.

Law firm Baker Tilly publishes note on advising Rockaway Ventures and Serpentine Ventures on the investment (legal due diligence and documents).
events.note: Publication date only; closing date not stated. Not used for T0.
